scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && aws s3 sync dist/assets/ s3://cameronjim.com-preview/assets/ --cache-control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" --delete --only-show-errors && aws s3 sync dist/ s3://cameronjim.com-preview/ --exclude "assets/*" --exclude "media/*" --cache-control "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate" --delete --only-show-errors && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E85A3WFAV9TCQ --paths "/*" --output text --query Invalidation.Status
scripts.upload:media: aws s3 sync media/ s3://cameronjim.com-preview/media/ --cache-control "public, max-age=604800" --only-show-errors
